draft.headline: Three xAI founding members launched Epochal to build predictive AI agents.
draft.threads_post:
A co-founder of Elon Musk's xAI just put $100M of his own money into a new AI startup.

Three founding members of xAI teamed up to launch Epochal. The new company is building AI agents designed to achieve "superhuman prediction," backed by a $100 million personal investment from co-founder Guodong Zhang.

Would you trust AI agents to make future predictions?
